## Manifest-driven agent activation restored

- Check update again exposes **Activate if newer** and **Restart agent**.
  Fleet update shortcuts default both controls on, restoring the combined
  check, stage, activate, and restart workflow.
- Every VPS resolves and verifies its own architecture-specific artifact from
  `version.json`, then activates its own staged SHA-256. Mixed x86_64/aarch64
  fleets do not require one shared binary hash.
- Clearing **Activate if newer** retains stage-only behavior and disables
  restart. The separate staged-SHA activation workflow remains available.

## Scope

- This corrects the frontend activation regression. The supporting API, command
  protocol, CLI, and agent behavior already exist; there is no persistence,
  REST, or protocol change.
